entities.name: Query protein 546 aa
observations: Sequence length is 546 aa; estimated molecular mass 60.82 kDa; theoretical pI 9.31; predicted net charge at pH 7 is +9.72.
Contains two PS_Dcarbxylase Pfam matches (PF02666.21), at residues 196–259 and 338–541.
Strong homologs are fungal mitochondrial phosphatidylserine decarboxylase proenzymes, with 41.6–44.1% identity, 83.2–86.8% query coverage, and E-values 6.46e-108 to 3.71e-112.

Likely undergoes autocatalytic cleavage to generate a large beta chain and small pyruvoyl-containing alpha chain; exact cleavage residue is inferred from homologous reference features, not directly experimentally mapped in this query.
Likely catalyzes phosphatidylserine decarboxylation to phosphatidylethanolamine using a covalently bound pyruvoyl group.
Likely associated with the mitochondrial inner membrane, based on homologous fungal proteins; direct localization of the query is not experimentally established.

entities.name: Phosphatidylserine decarboxylase
observations: Pyruvoyl is the catalytic cofactor generated by autocatalytic processing of a serine residue in the proenzyme.
Mitochondrial fungal homologs form a heterodimer consisting of a large beta chain and small alpha chain.
